records.title: י׳ שבט תשל״ו — מקטע אודיו חסר שאותר בהקלטה מקבילה
records.summary_researcher: JEM reports that a newly acquired recording from the Kievman family collection contained several seconds missing from another recording used while transcribing the Yud Shevat 5736 farbrengen. This is an explicit multi-witness case and therefore a strong Evidence Family candidate.

provenance.authorship_status: recording of the Rebbe at a farbrengen
provenance.source_witness: Kievman family recording collection; recording of radio broadcast, transferred to JEM
provenance.transmission_type: audio recording → family collection → JEM digital archive
provenance.textual_status: audio witness compared in relation to transcript work

witness.state: newly discovered parallel witness containing material missing from another version
witness.notes: Do not infer the full recording's completeness from the report.

access.reuse_notes: Record metadata and provenance; do not copy protected audio.

relations.basis: JEM explicitly reports comparison with another recording/transcript of the same farbrengen.

records.notes: Verified here only as a documented witness/provenance relationship, not as verification of the missing spoken words themselves.

records.title: פורים תשכ״ז — חמישה עדי הקלטה לאותה התוועדות
records.summary_researcher: JEM reports five versions of the Purim 5727 farbrengen: recordings associated with Ahron Goldstein, Berel Baumgarten, Leibel Raskin, Dovid Raskin, plus the WLCC collection. JEM states that the versions were digitized and compared with one another and with transcripts to produce the clearest/fullest possible audio.

provenance.authorship_status: recordings of the Rebbe at a farbrengen
provenance.source_witness: five separately identified recording holdings/witnesses reported by JEM
provenance.transmission_type: multiple historical recordings → JEM/Ashreinu digitization and comparison

witness.notes: Completeness of each individual witness is not established by the public report.

access.reuse_notes: Do not ingest protected audio without permission.

relations.basis: JEM explicitly identifies all five versions as recordings of the same farbrengen.

records.title: אוסף ר׳ שלום ישראל חודקוב — הקלטות יחידות ואירועים מצומצמים
records.summary_researcher: JEM reports that reels preserved by Rabbi Sholom Yisroel Hodakov include decades of audio, with unusual access to private yechidus in the Rebbe's room and talks to smaller groups, alongside farbrengen recordings. JEM states the reels were transferred for digitization, comparison and restoration.

provenance.authorship_status: historical recordings of events with the Rebbe
provenance.source_witness: reel-to-reel recordings from Rabbi Sholom Yisroel Hodakov's archive
provenance.textual_status: audio archive; individual event inventory not yet indexed here

witness.notes: Do not treat every reel/event as item-level indexed until an exact event endpoint is identified.

records.notes: Candidate pool for future response cases; no individual yechidus content is inferred from this collection-level report.

evidence_family_candidates.basis: JEM explicitly documents a missing segment in one version and recovery from a second recording witness; transcript work is also mentioned.
evidence_family_candidates.verification_limit: Exact transcript edition, exact timestamps, and the recovered wording have not yet been independently verified in the canonical repository.

evidence_family_candidates.basis: JEM explicitly documents five recording witnesses and comparison against transcripts.
evidence_family_candidates.verification_limit: Individual recording files, durations and overlap map are not yet indexed.
